title: Global Knowledge: the sovereign host
html:
The device running uDOS supplies its time and timezone. Set them through the host operating system. A location lookup is a separate operation that may require permission or a verified offline reference pack.

Example

When travelling, update the host timezone. If a map has no verified location fix, show that location is unavailable and let the user choose a known reference.

Source

Global Knowledge, Sovereign Host Reference. See also uDOS docs and specs.

title: User template: project Binder
html:
Copy this starter into a Binder and fill in the bracketed fields.

# [Project name]
## Mission
[What do we want to achieve?]
## Owner and review date
[Who owns the next decision? When will we review it?]
## Tasks
- [ ] [Next action]
## Sources
- [Title, source, and reason to keep it]
## Result
[Draft, decision, or edition]
## Visibility
[Local, Shared, or explicitly approved for Public]

Use the Mission and Binder guide to put it into practice.

title: How to start a Mission and collect the work
html:
1. Open Workflow → Mission Control and enter an objective, such as Plan an offline workshop.
  2. Open Tasks and record one concrete next action.
  3. Use the shared sidebar in Binders mode to select a Binder for your brief, source notes and draft.
  4. Open Queue to see background work and recent results.
  5. Review the finished material and choose its audience before preparing an edition.

Start with the project Binder template.

title: uDOS docs and specs: starter reference
html:
Product roles

uCore hosts the UI and services. uFlow owns workflow execution. uCode owns the BBC BASIC learning track and GridCore tools. Sonic Screwdriver covers hardware revival and deployment.

Knowledge and publishing

Global Knowledge is the reference baseline. Shared and Vault provide community and personal overlays. A reviewed edition is canonical on udo.guide and mirrored on udo.place. Approved graphics use cdn.udo.guide.

Authority

Knight publishes local editions. Sorcerer can publish to an approved cloud destination when configured. Wizard manages approved publishing origins and domains.

Read the sovereign host topic and the uCode manual and guide.

title: uCode manual and guide: first steps
html:
uCode teaches programming with BBC BASIC. At the prompt, enter an unnumbered command for immediate execution:

PRINT 2 + 2

To store a program, enter numbered lines. Use LIST to inspect them and RUN to execute them:

10 FOR I%=1 TO 3
20 PRINT I%
30 NEXT I%
RUN

Learning path

  1. First steps: output, input, variables and numbered programs.
  2. Control flow: conditions, loops, procedures and functions.
  3. Mode 7 and GridCore: character graphics, coordinates and layers.
  4. Projects: capsules, interactive programs and physical computing.

Source: the uCode User Guide and First Steps lesson. See uDOS docs and specs for the product map.
